verdict.rationale: Scribe's API reference exposes most of the core transcription workflow. It covers file and URL uploads (including YouTube and TikTok), diarization with a tunable threshold, word- and character-level timestamps, additional export formats, multichannel output, and natural-language transcript editing. It also offers async webhooks, realtime WebSocket transcription and official Python/Node SDKs, and the product page says captions and subtitles are available "in Studio or via API." missing for 10: an explicit statement or documented UI-vs-API parity mapping, API-level evidence for UI-marketed features (keyterm prompting, sound-event tagging, sensitive-info redaction, interactive transcript editing), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
